description: Configure Leave of Absence (LoA) and Reduced Activity (RA) settings.

content.name: enableStatusSystem
content.description: Enabling this unlocks the Leave of Absence (LoA) and Reduced Activity (RA) system, allowing staff to request these statuses and have them tracked.

content.name: enableLoa
content.description: If enabled, staff can request a Leave of Absence (LoA).

content.name: loaRole
content.description: Role given to users when they are on a Leave of Absence. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on LoA.

content.name: loaMaxDays
content.description: The maximum duration for a Leave of Absence in days. This limits how long staff can request to be on LoA for.

content.name: requireLoaApproval
content.description: If enabled, LoA requests will require approval from staff who have supervisor permissions or higher.

content.name: enableRa
content.description: If enabled, staff can request Reduced Activity (RA) status for when they are still working but at a reduced load.

content.name: raRole
content.description: Role given to users when they are on Reduced Activity. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on RA.

content.name: raMaxDays
content.description: The maximum duration for RA in days. This limits how long staff can request to be on RA for.

content.name: requireRaApproval
content.description: If enabled, RA requests will require approval from staff who have supervisor permissions or higher.

content.name: statusLogChannel
content.description: Channel where requests are sent for approval.

content.name: logStatusChanges
content.description: If enabled, any changes in staff status (going on/off LoA or RA) will be logged in the configured channel.

content.name: statusChangeLogChannel
content.description: Channel where status changes are logged. By default this uses your main log channel, but you can set a separate channel here.
